info.title: SevaNest API
info.description: Backend API for the Customer app, Worker app and Admin portal.

permissionCodes.description: The complete set of permission codes the role holds after the call (replaces the current set; send [] to remove all).

termsVersion.description: Must equal the current terms version.

privacyVersion.description: Must equal the current privacy version.

appType.description: Which app is signing in; decides the account type.
Which app is signing in; decides the account type.

otp.description: Digits only. The length is server configuration.

deviceId.description: Client-generated install id. One active session per device.

refreshToken.description: The current refresh token. It is single-use: a new one is returned.

token.description: FCM registration token for this device.

sizeBytes.description: Size in bytes of the file you will upload.

expectedSalary.description: Amount in rupees, positive. null clears it. The period is not defined by the specifications.

preferredLanguage.description: Language for my notifications and app. null clears it (platform default).

languages.description: Replaces the whole list; at least one.

categoryIds.description: The worker's roles (service categories). Replaces the whole set; at least one.

code.description: Stable machine code. Cannot be changed later.

url.description: Short-lived link to the private image. Do not store it.

workerId.description: Opaque worker reference for the next step (not the account id).

verification.description: Customers only ever see fully verified workers.

areaIds.description: Preferred work locations: ids of enabled service areas.

timeWindows.description: Daily available timings, applied every day. No weekdays are defined by the specifications.

workerId.description: Customers: the worker to block (a worker reference from search or a booking).

areaId.description: Service area of the job; only enabled areas.

workerId.description: A worker reference from search. The worker must be eligible; the booking then starts as MATCHED. Without it the booking starts as NEW_REQUEST and staff match a worker.

addressId.description: One of my saved addresses (404 if it is not mine or was removed; 422 OUTSIDE_SERVICE_AREA if its city is not the area's city). Only staff see it; the worker never does.

startDate.description: When the service should begin; today or later (India date).

budgetMaxMinor.description: Smallest currency unit (paise); not below budgetMinMinor.

budgetPeriod.description: What the budget is per. A label only: matching does not compare budgets (Q-39).

requirementNote.description: Free-text requirement for the worker (no HTML).

scheduledAt.description: schedule: a future date and time (ISO 8601).

startDate.description: confirm-worker: start date, today or later (India date).

reason.description: cancel: the reason (required). decline: the reason (recommended).

preferredLanguage.description: Language code; restricted to an allow-list when one is configured.

latitude.description: Set together with longitude, or omit both.

isDefault.description: Make this the default address (replaces the current default).

submitted.description: False while the document is still part of the open draft.

level.description: VERIFIED only when every required check is approved and not due for re-check.

url.description: Short-lived signed URL. Do not log or share it.

sizeBytes.description: Size in bytes of the file you will upload.

recheckAt.description: India date after which this approval stops counting and a re-check is due.

areaId.description: Service area of the job; only enabled areas.

ordering.description: Stable order: earliest submitted profile first. It is NOT a suitability ranking.

ranked.description: Always false: no scoring or ranking rule is defined (Q-46); every candidate meets every criterion.

bookingId.description: My booking that is waiting for payment.

providerPaymentId.description: The payment id the gateway SDK reported.

signature.description: The signature the gateway SDK reported. It is verified by the server.

note.description: What was done (e.g. refunded at the gateway, confirmed no action needed).

amountMinor.description: Amount in the smallest currency unit (paise).

eventCode.description: One of the events in GET /admin/notification-events.

dltTemplateId.description: India DLT: the registered template id this wording belongs to (SMS).

date.description: India date, from the booking start date up to today.

reason.description: Why the entry is being corrected (kept in the history).
Why a replacement is wanted (FR-REP-003). The specs define no reason list (Q-54).

workerId.description: The replacement worker (a worker reference from search or matching).

bookingId.description: My COMPLETED booking. The worker is the booking worker; it is never supplied by the caller.

score.description: Whole number from 1 to the configured top of the scale (RATING_SCALE_MAX).

bookingId.description: A booking I am a party to (as the customer or as the booking worker).

assigneeUserId.description: Admin user to own the ticket; defaults to me. Must hold support.manage.

note.description: Internal note, never shown to the user.

resolution.description: The outcome. Required on close (FRD FM-12); shown to the user who raised the ticket.

internal.description: true = an internal note the ticket creator never sees.
